title: Publications & Research — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: WhiteHouse College promotes a strong culture of research, innovation, and academic writing that contributes to knowledge creation and professional growth.
Premises of Nidi Secondary School & Indreni Campus

blocks.heading: Fostering Academic Excellence
paras: WhiteHouse College promotes a strong culture of research, innovation, and academic writing. Faculty members, researchers, and students are encouraged to engage in scholarly activities that contribute to knowledge creation and professional growth. The college supports research publications, conference participation, academic journals, and interdisciplinary studies.

groups.title: Academic Journals
text: Publication of peer-reviewed research in recognized national and international academic journals.

groups.title: Conference Presentations
text: Faculty and student presentations at national and international academic conferences and seminars.

groups.title: Collaborative Research
text: Interdisciplinary studies involving collaboration between faculty members, students, and external researchers.

groups.title: Innovation Projects
text: Research projects focused on technology innovation, educational advancement, and social impact.

blocks.heading: Knowledge Creation Through Research
paras: By supporting scholarly activities, we create opportunities for faculty and students to contribute meaningfully to their fields and advance understanding in technology, education, and innovation.

groups.title: Technology & Innovation
text: Research in artificial intelligence, IoT systems, software engineering, and emerging technologies with real-world applications.

groups.title: Educational Technology
text: Studies exploring digital learning tools, instructional design, online education, and technology-enhanced pedagogy.

groups.title: Applied Research
text: Practical research projects addressing specific problems in industry, education, and community development.

groups.title: Interdisciplinary Studies
text: Collaborative research combining perspectives from technology, education, business, and social sciences.

blocks.heading: Getting Involved in Research
paras: Students and faculty are encouraged to participate in research projects, publish findings, and present at conferences. This involvement develops critical thinking, strengthens professional credentials, and contributes to the advancement of knowledge in their respective fields.

blocks.heading: Join Our Research Community
paras: Explore opportunities to contribute to innovative research and scholarly work at WCBT.
